notes.title: Xenoterrestrial v3.10 "The Sheriff Patch" [11/17/24]
notes.notes:
Hello all! This is actually one of the bigger non-content updates this game has ever received, and it involves a number of bug fixes and balance changes related to Rampage Mode. This update also includes a complete overhaul to the sandbox to allow for better weapon mod testing on a greater variety of enemies.

Rampage Mode Changes:

 Added inactive animation for sentry
 Fixed bug where enemy rockets destroyed grenade explosion
 Changed orange resupply to activate at wave 15 instead of 20
 Added counter in the skills menu to make it easier to see how many WP are left
 Fix sig figs on counter in the win screen
 Fixed bug where Sheriff skin held weapons incorrectly.
 Fixed animation action point for gun on sheriff skin
 Batteries that respawn each wave now appear in some arenas
 Fixed a bug where enemy laser glow boundaries would not despawn properly
 Fixed bug where Shade fan attack can cause projectiles to stall
 Fixed a series of bugs pertaining to issues with teleporting in/out of the recovery area. This involved dashing, the grapple, and rocket riding. Some of these actions may no longer be available at certain times to avoid issues.
 Extended deactivation time when using the jackhammer on a sentry

Sandbox Changelist:

 Changed the dummy to actually have a unique texture
 Difficulty changing buttons no longer respawn enemies
 New enemy respawn button added
 Added new unlockable arena available after completeing 1-4
 Added new unlockable arena available after completeing 1-8
 Added ammo refill and enemy respawn buttons into all arenas


Thank you to Sheriff LaCombe for testing and reporting the issues that have been addressed in this patch.

notes.title: Xenoterrestrial Version 3.02 [11/12/2024]
notes.notes: Small update with discrete change for bugtesting. Imperceptible to normal players.

notes.title: Xenoterrestrial Update v2.60 [8/24/24]
notes.notes:
Larger patch today but not much to show for it. This update is primarily to prepare for the release of endless mode, but it does include some QOL changes.

Changes Include:

 Added new information to the enemies tab in the codex to make it overall more informative. This includes each enemy's health, classification, and which projectiles they have access to.
 Updated the descriptions for several weapon mods and alts to be more accurate and informative. 
 Rebalanced 2-SAC mode for the sniper to be more viable. It now doubles stored damage before changing phases.
 Fixed bug where you could use the jackhammer while dashing.

notes.title: Xenoterrestrial Version 2.57 [7/19/24]
notes.notes:
Changelog:


 Fixed bug where projectile-wall collision particles did not appear for the AR
 Fixed bug where parrying successfully did not reduce the parry recharge time
 Renamed Turbo Charge mod to Hypersonic
 Updated difficulty downgrade menu graphics and text
 Fixed floor animation in sandbox
 Added new bars that hover around the player and show the cooldown periods of all gear items

notes.title: Xenoterrestrial Update 2.56 [7/7/2024]
notes.notes:
Another QOL patch today with a few notable changes. Changes include:


 The game over screen now appears over the out of ammo indicator
 Complete overhaul of the tutorial with new textures, text, and a new layout
 Added a glowing animation to floor tiles in the sandbox and tutorial
 Added new text to the sandbox to show the purpose of different areas
 Changed transporters in applicable levels so that they can be used more than once per level (especially important in 2-S)
 Added a new codex entry describing basic ways to earn style points

notes.title: Xenoterrestrial Update 2.55 [7/6/24]
notes.notes:
Larger update today with a few mostly cosmetic changes and one large gameplay change.
Changes include:

 Updated graphics/colors in multiple menus to be more consistent with the games overall intended color scheme and look
 Added new options menu to the secondary (level) menu with ability to permanently downgrade the difficulty of the active save file.
 Reworked pitfalls to deal damage and respawn the player on the edge of the pit when they fall in instead of instantly killing them. This does 30-50 damage depending on the difficulty. 
 Updated the codex to reflect some changes made.
 Added new secret codes and changed old ones.

notes.title: Xenoterrestrial Update 2.52 [6/19/24]
notes.notes:
Small update today with a few QOL changes and slight mechanical tweaks. Changes include:


 Kinetic Hookpoints now preserve the angle you launched into them with when ejecting you instead of recalculating based on the hookpoint’s center. This should significantly reduce random deaths.
 A new indicator will appear and make a sound effect when a weapon is either out of ammo or not yet unlocked with appropriate text for both situations
 Fixed bug where new file prompt did not have the appropriate glow effects
 Updated credits

notes.title: Xenoterrestrial Update 2.22 [3/27/24]
notes.notes:
Smaller patch today (even if the file size seems larger than usual). This patch is meant to address a number of issues that I found while working on chapter 2 today. As always, most of the file size comes from internal progress on chapter 2.
Changes include:


 Internal Progress on Chapter 2
 Fixed inconsistency with codex unlocks
 Fixed issues with level selection buttons (in relation to secret level)
 Updated continue button to not appear for chapters higher than one if chapter one is not completed
 Fixed issue with progress reminder tip not appearing when it should
 Added new unique environment textures for the sandbox
 Buffed the Finisher SMG to be more viable by increasing damage 1.5x

I figured it's also worth noting that a new, more refined gameplay video is coming soon to the steam page that I think better represents the game. If I had to guess, this video will come out tomorrow.

notes.title: Xenoterrestrial Update 2.21 [3/19/24] - LEAVING EARLY ACCESS
notes.notes:
Small but significant patch today. While the file-size of this update is a bit larger than normal, there is little to actually see in game. That's because all of the changes in this update are either small aesthetic changes or internal progress on chapter 2. This update also officially marks the game's transition to formal release and leaving early access. Note that this does not change the fact that MORE CONTENT IS COMING SOON! I have a lot planned and there is a lot left to be added but I think it is more accurate to display this game as formally released than in early access. Changes in this update include:


 Updated disclaimer screen
 Updated button interaction in the bonus content menu
 Updated space background graphics in the secondary menu
 [strike]Secret Cheat Codes[/strike]
 Significant internal progress on chapter 2

notes.title: Xenoterrestrial Update 2.20 [3/6/24]
notes.notes:
Siginificant update today with some QOL stuff and internal changes as well as a fix for level 1-6.
Changes include:

 Added new confirmation message/method for making a new file.
 Fixed S-Rank kill requirement on 1-6 to be physically possible (meaning you can actually p-rank it now)
 Added badges to the secondary menu to mark progress on individual chapters. The first appears for having beat all the main sequence levels in a chapter. The second appears for P-Ranking all main sequence levels in the chapter. The third appears for 100% completing the chapter.
 Significant internal progress on chapter 2.

notes.title: Xenoterrestrial Update 2.19 (2/4/24)
notes.notes:
Larger update today with a number of QOL changes and significant internal progress on chapter 2. Accessible features include:

 Added a codex entry for the standard level pickups, which was strangely not previously implemented.
 Updated the textures on the pickups in the sandbox to show more obviously what the different pickups actually do.
 Updated the sandbox so that the player starts out with large quantities of all resources instead of having to go to the ammo refill pickup immediately.
 Added pickup messages for the sandbox pickups to better show what they do.
 Made it so that enemies respawn automatically when you select/reselect a difficulty in sandbox mode.
 Significant inaccessible internal progress on chapter 2 (this is the majority of the size of this update).

notes.title: Xenoterrestrial Update 2.18 [1/15/24]
notes.notes:
Two updates in one day? Long story short, I found another bug and decided to fix it now rather than later. Changes include:

 Fixed a bug where buttons in the secondary menu could be pressed before they were revealed.
 Minor internal changes related to progress on chapter 2.

notes.title: Xenoterrestrial Update 2.17 [1/15/23]
notes.notes:
Small patch today addressing a few small issues:

 Fixed a problem with weapon switching in 1-3.
 Fixed an inconsistency with the chapter completion counter in the secondary menu.
 New internal changes in preparation for chapter 2.

notes.title: Xenoterrestrial Update 2.16 [1/8/24]
notes.notes:
This is a simple bug fix patch that contains some additional back-end changes regarding progress on chapter 2.
The bug fixed is that:
All cutscenes will no longer be unlocked for no reason in the cutscene replay menu.

notes.title: Xenoterrestrial Update 2.15 [1/1/24]
notes.notes:
Small patch today with a small amount of content. Features include:

 Added an attack cooldown for swarmers to help prevent rapid collision detection.
 Added the cutscene replay menu under bonus content, allowing the player to rewatch cutscenes they've already seen.

notes.title: Xenoterrestrial Update 2.14
notes.notes:
Noticed a few more bugs while playing last night and figured I would get ahead of them now.
- Fixed a bug where dashing caused the cloak to deactivate incorrectly
- Fixed a bug where exiting the sandbox using the escape button would send the player to the secondary menu instead of the sandbox menu, preserving the sandbox equips
- Added internal progress on chapter 2 (not accessible)

notes.title: Update 2.13 10/27/23
notes.notes:
Day 2 Patch is Live. This one is a combination of bug fixes, qol, and balancing.
Changelog:


 Adjusted combat drone alt fire to fire slower
 Fixed bug where slam fire would activate due to combat drone
 Added new text to the primary menu warning players of how to manage their save files
 Fixed bug where the machine pistol would not aim properly.

notes.title: 10/26/23 Update 2.11 (bug fix)
notes.notes: While testing the game I noticed a game breaking bug in 1-2 that sends you to the wrong win screen upon completing the level. That has been fixed in this update.
